verses.original: אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֜י מִתֹּשָׁבֵ֣י גִלְעָד֮ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶל־ אַחְאָב֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ חַי־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנָ֔יו עָמַ֣דְתִּי יִהְיֶ֛ה אִם־ טַ֣ל וּמָטָ֑ר הָאֵ֖לֶּה הַשָּׁנִ֥ים כִּ֖י אִם־ לְפִ֥י דְבָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lî·yā·hū hat·tiš·bî mit·tō·šā·ḇê ḡil·‘āḏ way·yō·mer ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ḥay- ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·nāw ‘ā·maḏ·tî yih·yeh ’im- ṭal ū·mā·ṭār hā·’êl·leh haš·šā·nîm kî ’im- lə·p̄î ḏə·ḇā·rî
verses.literal: Now Elijah the Tishbite who was among the settlers of Gilead said to Ahab As surely as the LORD the God of Israel lives - before whom I stand there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except . . . at my word

verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lāw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then a revelation from the LORD came to [Elijah] . . .

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ מִזֶּ֔ה וּפָנִ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ קֵ֑דְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ miz·zeh ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯā lə·ḵā qê·ḏə·māh wə·nis·tar·tā bə·na·ḥal kə·rîṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Leave here turn eastward and hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith east of . . . . . . the Jordan

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְאֶת־ מֵהַנַּ֣חַל צִוִּ֔יתִי הָעֹרְבִ֣ים לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ֖ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh tiš·teh wə·’eṯ- mê·han·na·ḥal ṣiw·wî·ṯî hā·‘ō·rə·ḇîm lə·ḵal·kel·ḵā šām
verses.literal: And you are to drink - from the brook and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ כִּדְבַ֣ר וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh way·yê·leḵ kiḏ·ḇar way·yê·leḵ way·yê·šeḇ bə·na·ḥal kə·rîṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: So [Elijah] did what the LORD . . . had told him and he went and lived by the Brook of Cherith east of . . . . . . the Jordan

verses.original: וְהָעֹרְבִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֨ים ל֜וֹ לֶ֤חֶם וּבָשָׂר֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְלֶ֥חֶם וּבָשָׂ֖ר בָּעָ֑רֶב יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃ וּמִן־ הַנַּ֖חַל
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ō·rə·ḇîm mə·ḇî·’îm lōw le·ḥem ū·ḇā·śār bab·bō·qer wə·le·ḥem ū·ḇā·śār bā·‘ā·reḇ yiš·teh ū·min- han·na·ḥal
verses.literal: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning . . . . . . and evening and he would drink from the brook

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י מִקֵּ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים הַנָּ֑חַל וַיִּיבַ֣שׁ כִּ֛י הָיָ֥ה לֹֽא־ גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ yā·mîm han·nā·ḥal way·yî·ḇaš kî hā·yāh lō- ḡe·šem bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Some time later, however . . . . . . the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land

verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lāw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to [Elijah] . . .

verses.original: ק֣וּם לֵ֤ךְ צָרְפַ֙תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְצִיד֔וֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צִוִּ֥יתִי אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה שָׁ֛ם לְכַלְכְּלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qūm lêḵ ṣā·rə·p̄a·ṯāh ’ă·šer lə·ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·yā·šaḇ·tā šām hin·nêh ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’iš·šāh ’al·mā·nāh šām lə·ḵal·kə·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Get up [and] go to Zarephath - of Sidon and stay there Behold I have commanded vvv a widow there to provide for you

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ צָרְפַ֗תָה וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּֽה־ פֶּ֣תַח שָׁ֛ם אַלְמָנָ֖ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מְקֹשֶׁ֣שֶׁת עֵצִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר נָ֨א קְחִי־ לִ֧י מְעַט־ מַ֛יִם בַּכְּלִ֖י וְאֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ṣā·rə·p̄a·ṯāh way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·‘îr wə·hin·nêh- pe·ṯaḥ šām ’al·mā·nāh ’iš·šāh mə·qō·še·šeṯ ‘ê·ṣîm way·yiq·rā ’ê·le·hā way·yō·mar nā qə·ḥî- lî mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim bak·kə·lî wə·’eš·teh
verses.literal: So Elijah got up and went to Zarephath When he arrived at the city . . . gate there was a widow . . . gathering sticks Elijah called to her and said Please bring me a little water in a cup so that I may drink

verses.original: וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לָקַ֑חַת וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר נָ֥א לִֽקְחִי־ לִ֛י פַּת־ לֶ֖חֶם בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ lā·qa·ḥaṯ way·yiq·rā ’ê·le·hā way·yō·mar nā liq·ḥî- lî paṯ- le·ḥem bə·yā·ḏêḵ
verses.literal: And as she was going to get [it] he called to her and said Please bring me a piece of bread -

verses.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ חַי־ לִ֣י יֶשׁ־ אִם־ מָע֔וֹג כִּ֣י אִם־ מְלֹ֤א כַף־ קֶ֙מַח֙ בַּכַּ֔ד וּמְעַט־ שֶׁ֖מֶן בַּצַּפָּ֑חַת וְהִנְנִ֨י מְקֹשֶׁ֜שֶׁת שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵצִ֗ים וּבָ֙אתִי֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֙יהוּ֙ לִ֣י וְלִבְנִ֔י וַאֲכַלְנֻ֖הוּ וָמָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ḥay- lî yeš- ’im- mā·‘ō·wḡ kî ’im- mə·lō ḵap̄- qe·maḥ bak·kaḏ ū·mə·‘aṭ- še·men baṣ·ṣap·pā·ḥaṯ wə·hin·nî mə·qō·še·šeṯ šə·na·yim ‘ê·ṣîm ū·ḇā·ṯî wa·‘ă·śî·ṯî·hū lî wə·liḇ·nî wa·’ă·ḵal·nu·hū wā·mā·ṯə·nū
verses.literal: But she replied As surely as the LORD your God lives I have no bread only . . . a handful . . . of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug Look I am gathering a couple of sticks to take home and prepare [a meal] for myself and my son so that we may eat it and die

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ בֹּ֖אִי עֲשִׂ֣י כִדְבָרֵ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ בָרִאשֹׁנָה֙ עֲשִׂי־ לִ֣י קְטַנָּ֤ה עֻגָ֨ה מִ֠שָּׁם וְהוֹצֵ֣אתְ לִ֔י בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃ס תַּעֲשִׂ֖י וְלָ֣ךְ וְלִבְנֵ֔ךְ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’î ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā bō·’î ‘ă·śî ḵiḏ·ḇā·rêḵ ’aḵ ḇā·ri·šō·nāh ‘ă·śî- lî qə·ṭan·nāh ‘u·ḡāh miš·šām wə·hō·ṣēṯ lî bā·’a·ḥă·rō·nāh ta·‘ă·śî wə·lāḵ wə·liḇ·nêḵ
verses.literal: Do not be afraid Elijah said to her Go and do as you have said But first make me a small cake of bread from [what you have] and bring it out to me Afterward make [some] for yourself and your son

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָמַ֨ר כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֙מַח֙ לֹ֣א תִכְלָ֔ה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א תֶחְסָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֧וֹם יְהוָ֛ה תִּתֶּן גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar kaḏ haq·qe·maḥ lō ṯiḵ·lāh wə·ṣap·pa·ḥaṯ haš·še·men lō ṯeḥ·sār ‘aḏ yō·wm ha·šêm tit·tɛn ge·šem ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: for this is what the LORD the God of Israel says The jar of flour will not be exhausted and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain upon the face of the earth

verses.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתֹּ֧אכַל יָמִֽים׃ וָהִיא הוּא־ וּבֵיתָ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ wat·ta·‘ă·śeh kiḏ·ḇar ’ê·lî·yā·hū wat·tō·ḵal yā·mîm wå̄·hī hū- ū·ḇê·ṯāh
verses.literal: So she went and did according to the word of Elijah and there was food every day for Elijah and the woman and her household

verses.original: כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֙מַח֙ לֹ֣א כָלָ֔תָה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑ר כִּדְבַ֣ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּיַ֥ד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kaḏ haq·qe·maḥ lō ḵā·lā·ṯāh wə·ṣap·pa·ḥaṯ haš·še·men lō ḥā·sêr kiḏ·ḇar ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber bə·yaḏ ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: The jar of flour was not exhausted and the jug of oil did not run dry according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Elijah

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בֶּן־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בַּעֲלַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת וַיְהִ֤י חָלָ֕ה חָלְיוֹ֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ נְשָׁמָֽה׃ נֽוֹתְרָה־ בּ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥar had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ben- hā·’iš·šāh ba·‘ă·laṯ hab·bā·yiṯ way·hî ḥā·lāh ḥā·lə·yōw ḥā·zāq mə·’ōḏ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer lō- nə·šā·māh nō·wṯ·rāh- bōw
verses.literal: Later . . . . . . the son of the woman who owned the house . . . became ill and his sickness grew worse and worse until - no breath remained in him

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ מַה־ וָלָ֖ךְ לִּ֥י בָּ֧אתָ אֵלַ֛י לְהַזְכִּ֥יר אֶת־ עֲוֺנִ֖י וּלְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־ בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tō·mer ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū mah- wā·lāḵ lî bā·ṯā ’ê·lay lə·haz·kîr ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nî ū·lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- bə·nî
verses.literal: O man of God said [the woman] to Elijah what have you done to me Have you come . . . to remind me - of my iniquity and cause the death - of my son

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלֶ֖יהָ תְּנִֽי־ לִ֣י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֑ךְ וַיִּקָּחֵ֣הוּ מֵחֵיקָ֗הּ וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הָעֲלִיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב שָׁ֔ם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵ֖הוּ עַל־ מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā tə·nî- lî ’eṯ- bə·nêḵ way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū mê·ḥê·qāh way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ’el- hā·‘ă·lî·yāh ’ă·šer- hū yō·šêḇ šām way·yaš·ki·ḇê·hū ‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: But Elijah said to her Give me your son So he took him from her arms carried him to the upper room where he was staying . . . and laid him on his own bed

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י הֲ֠גַם הֲרֵע֖וֹתָ עַל־ הָאַלְמָנָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֨י מִתְגּוֹרֵ֥ר עִמָּ֛הּ לְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־ בְּנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy hă·ḡam hă·rê·‘ō·w·ṯā ‘al- hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî miṯ·gō·w·rêr ‘im·māh lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- bə·nāh
verses.literal: Then he cried out to the LORD O LORD my God have You also brought tragedy on this widow - vvv who has opened her home to me . . . by causing - her son {to die}

verses.original: וַיִּתְמֹדֵ֤ד עַל־ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י נָ֛א הַזֶּ֖ה הַיֶּ֥לֶד נֶֽפֶשׁ־ תָּ֥שָׁב עַל־ קִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·mō·ḏêḏ ‘al- hay·ye·leḏ šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm way·yiq·rā ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy nā haz·zeh hay·ye·leḏ ne·p̄eš- tā·šāḇ ‘al- qir·bōw
verses.literal: Then he stretched himself out over the child three times and cried out to the LORD - O LORD my God please let this boy’s life return to him

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע בְּק֣וֹל אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ הַיֶּ֛לֶד נֶֽפֶשׁ־ וַתָּ֧שָׁב עַל־ קִרְבּ֖וֹ וַיֶּֽחִי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl ’ê·lî·yā·hū hay·ye·leḏ ne·p̄eš- wat·tā·šāḇ ‘al- qir·bōw way·ye·ḥî
verses.literal: And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah and the child’s life returned to him and he lived

verses.original: אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֨ח הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיֹּרִדֵ֤הוּ מִן־ הָעֲלִיָּה֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ לְאִמּ֑וֹ רְאִ֖י בְּנֵֽךְ׃ חַ֥י אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ hay·ye·leḏ way·yō·ri·ḏê·hū min- hā·‘ă·lî·yāh hab·bay·ṯāh way·yit·tə·nê·hū lə·’im·mōw rə·’î bə·nêḵ ḥay ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·yō·mer
verses.literal: Then Elijah - took the child brought him down from the upper room into the house and gave him to his mother Look your son is alive Elijah declared

verses.original: הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ עַתָּה֙ זֶ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אָ֑תָּה אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה בְּפִ֖יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·’iš·šāh wat·tō·mer ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū ‘at·tāh zeh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî ’āt·tāh ’îš ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·p̄î·ḵā ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: Then the woman said to Elijah Now . . . I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is truth
